name: PerfMon
tagline: Windows 11 Task Manager & Precision Telemetry Suite
short_description: A native macOS system monitor with WebMon v2.3-parity custom widget studio (tabbed Main/Header/Footer designer, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with hover move-cross mini-toolbar, static text, environment variables, date/time & last-refresh tokens, 10 font families, custom surface backgrounds, multi-step undo, Copy Widget, and scrollbar-free full-card expansion), cross-app Low Effort Suite theme and Dock icon sync, per-process/socket network speeds, and eight graph styles.
spotlight_description: PerfMon v2.3.0 brings full WebMon v2.3 widget customization parity to desktop telemetry cards and modular HUDs: a tabbed Main/Header/Footer component designer, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with edge-to-edge full-card bleed and a hover 4-way move-cross mini-toolbar, static text, environment variables ($USER, $HOST, $HOME, $SHELL), date/time and last-refresh tokens, per-token typography across 10 font families, custom widget surface backgrounds (Solid, Two-Tone Gradient, Procedural Wallpaper), 30-step Undo, Copy Widget with new-name prompt, and scrollbar-free full-card item expansion.
catalog_description: A native macOS system monitor with WebMon v2.3-parity custom widget studio (tabbed Main/Header/Footer designer, toggleable Header & Footer chrome, env/date/refresh tokens, 10 font families, custom backgrounds, multi-step undo & Copy Widget), cross-app theme sync, per-process network speeds, eight graph styles, and a custom menu bar builder.
spotlight_chips: Low Effort Suite Theme & Icon Sync
